senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; v. צנף a. derivatives) [the bright headdress,] turban esp. the priest’s turban.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 1:10">Tosef. Yoma I, 10</cite> <he>נוטל מִצְנַפְתּוֹ של וכ׳</he> he took the turban from the head of one of them, and they knew that the count for the lot was to begin with him; <cite ref="Yoma 25a:4">Yoma 25ᵃ</cite>.
Ib. מ׳ בבגדי חול וכ׳ is there a turban (mitsnefeth) among common dresses (not used at the priestly service)? Ib. VII, 5; a. fr.
